answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof-of-burn licensing across the trust canyon of decentralized peers. To operate, each node must provably destroy scarce jade tokens into an unspendable address. An attacker incurs the non-refundable cost of sacrificing liquid capital per identity, preventing collateral recycling. Batch activations advance at the slow pace of a glacier to deter rapid replay, yet this continuous burning inevitably disadvantages low-budget honest agents.
